- content/english/blog/instant-pot-arroz-caldo.md

- content/english/blog/instant-pot-chicken-adobo.md
- content/english/blog/miracle-isaiah-david.md
- content/english/blog/worship-pads-solo-guitar.md
- content/english/blog/dnpap-song-resources.md

Note: miracle-isaiah-david.md is a personal faith/family post and dnpap-song-resources.md is a short resource-list post. Judge each against what the guide says for its type; a short link-list post does not need to be padded out.

For each post, report concrete voice violations with EXACT quotes and line numbers, focused on:
1. AI tells listed in the guide (hollow openers like "When it comes to", transition spam like "Additionally"/"Furthermore"/"Moreover"/"That said", "seamless", "it's worth noting", "In conclusion", significance inflation, thesaurus words) and generic food-blog filler ("tantalize your taste buds", "delicious", "flavorful", "perfect for any occasion")
2. Corporate/no-subject voice ("users should", "it is recommended", "one might")
3. Em dashes or en dashes (— or –) which are BANNED; only plain hyphens allowed
4. Summary sandwiches, fake balance, parallel bullet drone (3+ bullets starting with the same word)
5. Section intros with no specific detail (no number, name, place, or failure/mistake)
6. Flat/generic H2 headings that read like a product manual instead of having personality
7. Missing first-person voice, especially in the opening
8. Currency amounts (dollar/peso figures or "what I paid") which are BANNED
9. Weak closings ("hope this helps", "in conclusion", "enjoy!") instead of landing on what the author actually does
10. Frontmatter `description` and `meta_title` that sound SEO-stuffed or bot-written rather than personal

Output format: group findings by file. For each finding give `line number` + exact quote + which rule it breaks + a one-line suggested fix in the author's voice (first person, plain words, no em dashes). Be specific and quote verbatim so the fixes can be applied directly. Also give each post a verdict: CLEAN, LIGHT POLISH, or DEEP REWRITE, and list which H2 sections need the most work.

Do NOT edit any files. Report only.
